data.desc: AchieveRx, The Quit Company (Nasdaq: ACHV; QUIT effective November 10, 2026 ; formerly doing business as Achieve Life Sciences, Inc. ) is a late-stage pharmaceutical company with a singular focus on nicotine dependence. AchieveRx's mission is to develop medicine for people who want to quit smoking or vaping. That medicine is cytisinicline, an investigational compound. Three ideas guide the Company: simplicity, science, and second chances, for good.
